title: People Who Inject Drugs (PWID)
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
Treatment of Tuberculosis in Special Cases

blocks.text: PWID-TB patient who are on medication assisted therapy may require methadone dose adjustment. Rifampicin reduces methadone concentration, which may lead to rifampicin-induced methadone withdrawal. In that case, the methadone dose should be adjusted according to individual dosage (Refer to methadone treatment guidelines).
